gloss: to rise, to ascend (sun, smoke, etc.)

definitions.explanation: Used for things that rise naturally — the sun, moon, smoke, steam, etc. Describes upward motion of natural phenomena rather than physical climbing by a person.

examples.japanese: {東|ひがし}の{空|そら}に{月|つき}が{昇|のぼ}った。
examples.english: The moon rose in the eastern sky.

examples.japanese: {初日|はつひ}の{出|で}を{見|み}ようと、{山頂|さんちょう}で{日|ひ}が{昇|のぼ}るのを{待|ま}った。
examples.english: To see the first sunrise of the year, I waited at the summit for the sun to rise.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No transitive pair.

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing rising or completed rise. {日|ひ}が{昇|のぼ}っている = 'the sun has risen / is rising.'

KANJI NOTE:
Three kanji are used for のぼる, each with a different meaning:
- {昇|のぼ}る: natural rising (sun, moon) — this entry
- {登|のぼ}る: climbing (mountains, stairs)
- {上|のぼ}る: going up (general upward movement)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日|ひ}が{昇|のぼ}る: the sun rises
- {太陽|たいよう}が{昇|のぼ}る: the sun rises
- {月|つき}が{昇|のぼ}る: the moon rises

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {登|のぼ}る: to climb (physical climbing)
- {上|のぼ}る: to go up (general)
- {上|あ}がる: to rise, to go up
